mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sky_take_out.orders ( number, status, user_id, address_book_id, order_time, checkout_time, pay_method, pay_status, amount, remark, user_name, phone, address, consignee, cancel_reason, rejection_reason, cancel_time, estimated_delivery_time, delivery_status, delivery_time, pack_amount, tableware_number, tableware_status, remark_flavor, remark_delivery, remark_urgency, ai_parse_status ) VALUES ( #{number}, #{status}, #{userId}, #{addressBookId}, #{orderTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{payMethod}, #{payStatus}, #{amount}, #{remark}, #{userName}, #{phone}, #{address}, #{consignee}, #{cancelReason}, #{rejectionReason}, #{cancelTime}, #{estimatedDeliveryTime}, #{deliveryStatus}, #{deliveryTime}, #{packAmount}, #{tablewareNumber}, #{tablewareStatus}, #{remarkFlavor}, #{remarkDelivery}, #{remarkUrgency}, #{aiParseStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sky_take_out.orders WHERE status = #{status} AND order_time <= #{orderTime}

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, SUM(amount) AS turnover FROM sky_take_out.orders WHERE status = 5 AND DATE_FORMAT(order_time,'%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(order_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(id) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(IF(status = 5, 1, 0)), 0) AS validOrderCount FROM sky_take_out.orders WHERE DATE_FORMAT(order_time,'%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end} GROUP BY date ORDER BY date
mapper.update: UPDATE sky_take_out.orders SET status = 6, cancel_reason = '支付超时', cancel_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
UPDATE sky_take_out.orders SET status = #{status}, pay_status = #{payStatus}, checkout_time = #{checkoutTime} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM sky_take_out.orders WHERE status = #{completed} AND DATE_FORMAT(order_time,'%Y-%m-%d') BETWEEN #{begin} AND #{end}
